name: Potter Signe
title: The Crockery
examine: Clay to the elbows and perfectly content about it. She reads people the way she reads a thrown pot — by where the wobble starts.
lines: River clay, mountain fire, my hands. Everything in this shop is local except the patience.
The High City eats off silver and calls my work rustic. The High City's kitchens buy from me by the cartload and call it something else.
The mound out back breathes all night on a burn day. First time you hear it you'll think the mountain's alive. Second time you'll know it is.
